semver-release.yml.original:
name: SemVer Release

# Biweekly stable releases + manual urgent releases from master
# Normal commits to master only create dev releases (via publish-dev.yml)
on:
  schedule:
    # Every other Wednesday at 10:00 UTC (biweekly-gate skips odd weeks)
    - cron: '0 10 * * 3'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force:
        description: 'Force a patch when no fix, feat, or perf commit exists'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean

permissions:
  contents: read

# Serialize with every other workflow that pushes to master (sync-tool-docs,
# addon-publish-dev, locale-sync, sync-ratchet-baselines). semantic-release's
# internal push aborts hard when origin/master moves mid-run ("Upstream branch
# ... has changed") and that abort is not retryable from inside the action, so
# the only safe fix is to keep master writers from overlapping.
# cancel-in-progress stays false: a queued release must run, not be cancelled.
concurrency:
  group: master-write
  cancel-in-progress: false
  # queue: max keeps every queued run waiting FIFO. The default single-slot
  # queue evicts the OLDER pending run when a new one queues, which could
  # silently drop a queued release behind a bot push.
  queue: max

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.13"

jobs:
  # Skip on odd ISO weeks (biweekly cadence) unless manually triggered
  biweekly-gate:
    name: Biweekly schedule gate
    # Releases of this repository only; the release jobs depend on this one.
    if: github.repository == 'homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      should_run: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.should_run }}
    steps:
      - name: Check if this is a release week
        id: gate
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" != "schedule" ]; then
            echo "should_run=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Manual or non-scheduled trigger, proceeding"
            exit 0
          fi
          WEEK=$((10#$(date +%V)))
          if [ $((WEEK % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "should_run=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Even week ($WEEK), proceeding with release"
          else
            echo "should_run=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Odd week ($WEEK), skipping release"
          fi

  # Check for changes since last release (skip if no changes)
  check-changes:
    name: Check for releasable changes
    needs: biweekly-gate
    if: needs.biweekly-gate.outputs.should_run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      has_changes: ${{ steps.check.outputs.has_changes }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for releasable commits since last tag
        id: check
        run: |
          # Get latest non-dev tag
          LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v[0-9]*' --exclude '*dev*' 2>/dev/null || echo "")

          if [ -z "$LATEST_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No previous release found, proceeding"
            echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Latest stable tag: $LATEST_TAG"

          # Match every commit form that Python Semantic Release can bump.
          CHANGES=$(git log $LATEST_TAG..HEAD --oneline -E \
            --grep="^(feat|fix|perf|refactor)(\(.+\))?!?:" \
            --grep="^[a-z]+(\(.+\))?!:" \
            --grep="^BREAKING[ -]CHANGE:" | head -5)

          if [ -n "$CHANGES" ] && [ "${{ inputs.force }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "::error::Force pins the next version to patch, but releasable commits exist:"
            echo "$CHANGES"
            echo "Dispatch again without force so semantic-release selects the correct level."
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ -n "$CHANGES" ] || [ "${{ inputs.force }}" = "true" ]; then
            echo "has_changes=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Changes found:"
            echo "$CHANGES"
          else
            echo "has_changes=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "No releasable changes since $LATEST_TAG"
          fi

  # Validate Docker build before committing to a release
  validate-docker:
    name: Validate Docker Build
    # Releases of this repository only, like biweekly-gate.
    if: github.repository == 'homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: true

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4

      - name: Build addon image (no push)
        uses: ./.github/actions/docker-build-python-base-fallback
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./homeassistant-addon/Dockerfile
          push: false
          platforms: linux/amd64

  # Semantic versioning and release creation
  semantic-release:
    needs: [check-changes, validate-docker]
    if: needs.check-changes.outputs.has_changes == 'true'
    # This display name is load-bearing: sync-integration-mirror.yml's gate
    # matches the triggering run's jobs by this exact name to decide whether a
    # release happened. Rename it together with that gate's matcher.
    name: Semantic Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      released: ${{ steps.semantic.outputs.released }}
      version: ${{ steps.semantic.outputs.version }}
    permissions:
      contents: write      # Required to push commits and tags
      id-token: write      # Required for trusted publishing
      pull-requests: write # Required to create pull requests
      issues: write        # Required for GitHub releases

    steps:
    # Generate GitHub App token with bypass permissions for tag creation
    - name: Generate GitHub App token
      id: app-token
      uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3
      with:
        app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
        private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        permission-contents: write
      # Fallback to RELEASE_TOKEN (PAT) or GITHUB_TOKEN if app credentials not configured
      continue-on-error: true

    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      with:
        fetch-depth: 0
        # Priority: GitHub App token > RELEASE_TOKEN (PAT) > GITHUB_TOKEN
        token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Python Semantic Release
      id: semantic
      uses: python-semantic-release/python-semantic-release@b700dbeb1f431a0fcc30a79f3f0869407fe07278 # v10.7.0
      with:
        # Use GitHub App token with bypass permissions
        github_token: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        verbosity: "2"
        # Force pins the bump to patch and is rejected above when releasable
        # commits exist, so it cannot override a required minor/major bump.
        force: ${{ inputs.force && 'patch' || '' }}
        # Don't create GitHub release here - we'll create a draft below
        vcs_release: "false"

    - name: Install uv for the integration archive
      if: steps.semantic.outputs.released == 'true'
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
      with:
        # renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=astral-sh/uv
        version: "0.13.4"

    - name: Build the integration ZIP
      if: steps.semantic.outputs.released == 'true'
      run: uv run -s scripts/build_component_zip.py

    - name: Create draft GitHub release
      if: steps.semantic.outputs.released == 'true'
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token || secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: |
        VERSION="${{ steps.semantic.outputs.version }}"
        TAG="v${VERSION}"

        # Extract changelog for this version, capped at GitHub's release-body limit
        # (an over-long body is a 422 that strands the already-pushed tag).
        python3 scripts/extract_release_notes.py --version "$VERSION" --out release_notes.md
        if [ ! -s release_notes.md ]; then
          # An empty extract means either no "## v${VERSION}" heading or an
          # empty section, and the file cannot tell those apart — so warn
          # instead of letting a one-line release body pass for a normal run.
          echo "::warning::no changelog section extracted for v${VERSION} — releasing with fallback notes"
          echo "Release v${VERSION}" > release_notes.md
        fi

        # Release Publish makes this public only after PyPI serves its pin.
        gh release create "$TAG" dist/integration/ha_mcp_tools.zip \
          --verify-tag \
          --title "$TAG" \
          --notes-file release_notes.md \
          --draft

        echo "✓ Created draft release $TAG"

    - name: Copy changelog to addon directory
      if: steps.semantic.outputs.released == 'true'
      run: |
        set -e
        cp CHANGELOG.md homeassistant-addon/CHANGELOG.md
        git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
        git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
        git add homeassistant-addon/CHANGELOG.md
        git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "chore(addon): sync changelog for Home Assistant add-on [skip ci]"
        # Master can advance between checkout and this push (bot commits from
        # other workflows); retry with a rebase instead of failing the release.
        # Mirrors the loop in sync-tool-docs.yml.
        for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
          if git push; then
            echo "Synced addon changelog (attempt ${attempt})."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Push rejected on attempt ${attempt}; rebasing onto origin/master and retrying."
          # Abort a conflicted rebase so later attempts fail for the real reason.
          git pull --rebase origin master || {
            git rebase --abort 2>/dev/null || true
            echo "::error::Rebase onto origin/master failed; aborting retries."
            exit 1
          }
        done
        echo "::error::Could not push addon changelog sync after 5 attempts."
        exit 1


    - name: Update stable git tag
      if: steps.semantic.outputs.released == 'true'
      run: |
        # Move the 'stable' tag to point to the new release
        VERSION="${{ steps.semantic.outputs.version }}"
        echo "Updating 'stable' tag to point to v$VERSION"

        # Delete existing stable tag (local and remote)
        git tag -d stable 2>/dev/null || true
        git push origin :refs/tags/stable 2>/dev/null || true

        # Create new stable tag pointing to the release commit
        git tag stable "v$VERSION"
        git push origin stable

        echo "✓ 'stable' tag now points to v$VERSION"

  # Build and push addon Docker images
  build-addon:
    needs: semantic-release
    if: needs.semantic-release.outputs.released == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/addon-publish.yml
    with:
      version: ${{ needs.semantic-release.outputs.version }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

  # Update addon config.yaml after images are published
  update-addon-config:
    needs: [semantic-release, build-addon]
    if: needs.semantic-release.outputs.released == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_update-addon-config.yml
    with:
      version: ${{ needs.semantic-release.outputs.version }}
    secrets:
      RELEASE_APP_ID: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_ID }}
      RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      RELEASE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN }}
    permissions:
      contents: write

name: Release Publish

on:
  # Trigger after SemVer Release completes
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["SemVer Release"]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [ main, master ]
  # Also support manual dispatch
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io

jobs:
  prepare:
    name: Prepare release metadata
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      release_tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.release_tag }}
      should_publish: ${{ steps.version.outputs.should_publish }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: master
          fetch-depth: 0

      # Guard against the workflow_run trigger firing on odd-week SemVer Release
      # runs that were correctly gated out. A SemVer Release whose biweekly-gate
      # / check-changes / semantic-release jobs all skipped still ends with
      # conclusion=success (skipped != failed), which would otherwise republish
      # the existing stable version from master HEAD with whatever post-tag
      # commits have accumulated — same :stable / :latest label, different bits.
      # Publish only when master HEAD is at the latest stable tag's commit.
      - name: Verify master is at the latest stable tag
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          # Resolve the latest stable tag. A real failure (corrupt repo, shallow
          # clone missing tags, etc.) should fail loudly — only exit-code 128
          # from `git describe` means "no matching tags exist in history" and is
          # benign for a fresh repo with no stable releases yet.
          set +e
          LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 --match 'v[0-9]*' --exclude '*dev*' 2>&1)
          DESCRIBE_RC=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$DESCRIBE_RC" -eq 128 ]; then
            echo "::warning::No stable tag found; skipping Release Publish."
            echo "should_publish=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "version=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "release_tag=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          fi
          echo "release_tag=$LATEST_TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Latest stable tag: $LATEST_TAG"

          # Read the version from pyproject.toml AT THE TAG, not master HEAD, so
          # we publish what was tagged even if master has advanced. Prevents the
          # "workflow_dispatch bumped pyproject ahead of tag" corner case.
          VERSION=$(git show "$LATEST_TAG:pyproject.toml" \
            | grep '^version = ' | sed 's/version = "\(.*\)"/\1/')

          # pushes follow-up housekeeping commits to master (changelog sync,
          # addon version bump — all `[skip ci]`). HEAD != tag in that case,
          # but the release IS current. Mirror semver-release.yml's check-changes
          # logic: block only if there are releasable commits
          # on master since the tag that would have produced a new version.

            --grep='^[a-z]+(\(.+\))?!:' \

            if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
              echo "::notice::Manual dispatch: unreleased commits exist on master since $LATEST_TAG. Forcing republish of $LATEST_TAG from the tag ref (master HEAD $HEAD_SHA is being ignored)."

              echo "Building \`$LATEST_TAG\` ($TAG_SHA); unreleased commits on master were ignored." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            else
              echo "::notice::Unreleased commits exist on master since $LATEST_TAG; no new release to publish — skipping."
              echo "should_publish=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              echo "## Release Publish skipped" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "master has releasable commits since the latest stable tag \`$LATEST_TAG\` but no new tag was cut, so republishing \`$LATEST_TAG\` would be misleading." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              echo "This is expected on biweekly-gate odd weeks; the re-triggered \`workflow_run\` is being correctly ignored." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
              exit 0
            fi
          fi

          echo "should_publish=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Release version: $VERSION (tag $LATEST_TAG)"
          echo "## Release Publish — $VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "Building from tag \`$LATEST_TAG\` ($TAG_SHA)." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if [ "$TAG_SHA" != "$HEAD_SHA" ]; then
            echo "(master HEAD is $HEAD_SHA — post-tag housekeeping commits only, no releasable changes.)" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

        if: ${{ needs.publish_pypi.result == 'success' && needs.publish_docker.result == 'success' }}

            --output server.json \
            --version "$VERSION" \
            --oci-image "$IMAGE"

        if: ${{ needs.publish_pypi.result == 'success' && needs.publish_docker.result == 'success' }}

        with:
          # renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=astral-sh/uv
          version: "0.13.4"

      - name: Validate server manifest
        if: ${{ needs.publish_pypi.result == 'success' && needs.publish_docker.result == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          uv run --frozen python scripts/validate_server_manifest.py server.json

      - name: Login to MCP Registry
        if: ${{ needs.publish_pypi.result == 'success' && needs.publish_docker.result == 'success' }}
        run: ./mcp-publisher login github-oidc

      - name: Publish server to MCP Registry
        if: ${{ needs.publish_pypi.result == 'success' && needs.publish_docker.result == 'success' }}
        run: |
          set +e  # Don't exit on error
          OUTPUT=$(./mcp-publisher publish --server server.json 2>&1)
          EXIT_CODE=$?
          echo "$OUTPUT"

          # If publish succeeded, we're done
          if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "✓ Successfully published to MCP Registry"
            exit 0
          fi

          # If version already exists, treat as success
          if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -qi "cannot publish duplicate version\|version.*already.*exist\|already.*published"; then
            echo "⚠ Version $VERSION already exists in MCP Registry (published previously)"
            echo "✓ Treating as success"
            exit 0
          fi

          # Any other error is a real failure
          echo "✗ Failed to publish to MCP Registry"
          exit $EXIT_CODE

      - name: Skip MCP publish
        if: ${{ needs.publish_pypi.result != 'success' || needs.publish_docker.result != 'success' }}
        run: |
          echo "Skipping MCP publish because one or more upstream publish jobs failed."

name: Publish Dev Channel

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths-ignore:
      - '*.md'
      - 'docs/**'
      - '.github/workflows/close-inactive-issues.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io

# Restrict permissions by default
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Skip if commit is from semantic-release (version bump commits)
  check-skip:
    # Dev publishing of this repository only; every later job depends on this one.
    if: github.repository == 'homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      should_skip: ${{ steps.check.outputs.should_skip }}
    steps:
      - name: Check if should skip
        id: check
        env:
          # Use env var to avoid shell interpretation of backticks in commit messages
          COMMIT_MSG: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$COMMIT_MSG" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ ]] || [[ "$COMMIT_MSG" =~ "chore(release)" ]]; then
            echo "should_skip=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "Skipping dev publish for release commit"
          else
            echo "should_skip=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  prepare:
    needs: check-skip
    if: needs.check-skip.outputs.should_skip != 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      dev_version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.dev_version }}
      short_sha: ${{ steps.version.outputs.short_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # Full history: the dev version number is the commit count.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
        with:
          # renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=astral-sh/uv
          version: "0.13.4"

      - name: Generate dev version
        id: version
        run: |
          SHORT_SHA=$(echo "${{ github.sha }}" | cut -c1-7)
          # <next release>.dev<commit count>: the same commit produces the
          # SAME number in every workflow (PyPI/Docker here, the dev app), so
          # all surfaces report one dev version. See the script for why the
          # base is the NEXT release and which commit it counts.
          DEV_VERSION=$(scripts/dev_version.sh)

          echo "dev_version=$DEV_VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "short_sha=$SHORT_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Dev version: $DEV_VERSION (sha: $SHORT_SHA)"
          echo "$DEV_VERSION" > dev-version.txt

      # The mirror sync pins the HACS pre-release to exactly this build, so it
      # reads the number from here rather than recomputing it.
      - name: Hand the dev version to the mirror sync
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7
        with:
          name: dev-version
          path: dev-version.txt
          retention-days: 7

  publish-pypi-dev:
    name: Publish PyPI (dev channel)
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: pypi-dev
      url: https://pypi.org/p/ha-mcp-dev
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write  # Required for PyPI trusted publishing
    env:
      DEV_VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.dev_version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: true

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
        with:
          # renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=astral-sh/uv
          version: "0.13.4"

      - name: Temporarily set package name and version for dev build
        run: |
          # Replace package name and version in pyproject.toml for build only
          sed -i 's/^name = "ha-mcp"/name = "ha-mcp-dev"/' pyproject.toml
          sed -i 's/^version = .*/version = "'"$DEV_VERSION"'"/' pyproject.toml
          # Replace package name in version lookup
          sed -i "s/version('ha-mcp')/version('ha-mcp-dev')/g" src/ha_mcp/__main__.py
          # Add ha-mcp-dev entry point with DEBUG logging
          sed -i '/^ha-mcp = "ha_mcp.__main__:main"$/a ha-mcp-dev = "ha_mcp.__main__:main_dev"' pyproject.toml
          echo "Building ha-mcp-dev version: $DEV_VERSION"
          grep -E '^(name|version) = ' pyproject.toml
          echo "Entry points:"
          grep -A5 '^\[project.scripts\]' pyproject.toml

      - name: Build distribution
        run: uv build

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086 # release/v1
        with:
          packages-dir: dist
          skip-existing: true

  publish-docker-dev:
    name: Publish Docker (dev channel)
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: true

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4

      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6 # v4
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image (dev tags)
        uses: ./.github/actions/docker-build-python-base-fallback
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          push: true
          # Do NOT push :latest from dev builds. :latest is reserved for stable
          # releases (release-publish.yml pushes :latest + :stable together).
          # Dev builds run on every push to master, so tagging :latest here
          # clobbers the default tag with bleeding-edge dev between the biweekly
          # stable releases. The dev channel is :dev (rolling) + :dev-<sha>. (#1475)
          tags: |
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}:dev
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}:dev-${{ needs.prepare.outputs.short_sha }}
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          build-args: |
            BUILD_VERSION=${{ needs.prepare.outputs.dev_version }}

  create-prerelease:
    name: Create GitHub pre-release
    # HACS installs this tag, and Home Assistant then installs its pin from
    # PyPI: only master's build is the dev pre-release (a branch dispatch
    # computes master's number), and only once PyPI serves it.
    needs: [prepare, publish-pypi-dev]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # The notes list the commits since the previous dev build's tag.
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      # HACS installs a pre-release from the commit its tag names, so that
      # commit must carry the component stamped with this build's version and
      # its ha-mcp-dev pin (#2763). The stamp goes on a commit of its own that
      # only the tag references; master is untouched.
      - name: Wait for the build on PyPI
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.dev_version }}
        run: |
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            if curl -fsS -o /dev/null "https://pypi.org/pypi/ha-mcp-dev/${VERSION}/json"; then
              echo "PyPI serves ha-mcp-dev ${VERSION}"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 30
          done
          echo "::error::PyPI never served ha-mcp-dev ${VERSION}; not tagging a component that pins it."
          exit 1

      - name: Stamp the component for this build
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.dev_version }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          python3 scripts/stamp_component_version.py \
            --component-dir custom_components/ha_mcp_tools \
            --version "${VERSION%.dev*}" --pin "$VERSION" --dist ha-mcp-dev
          git commit --quiet -am "chore(internal): stamp the component for dev build ${VERSION} [skip ci]"

      - name: Install uv for the integration archive
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
        with:
          # renovate: datasource=github-releases depName=astral-sh/uv
          version: "0.13.4"

      - name: Build the integration ZIP
        run: uv run -s scripts/build_component_zip.py

      - name: Create pre-release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.dev_version }}
          SHORT_SHA: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.short_sha }}
        run: |
          TAG="v${VERSION}"

          RELEASE=$(gh api graphql \
            -f query='query($owner: String!, $name: String!, $tag: String!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { release(tagName: $tag) { isDraft } } }' \
            -f owner="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY%%/*}" -f name="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY#*/}" -f tag="$TAG" \
            --jq '.data.repository.release | if . == null then "absent" elif .isDraft then "draft" else "published" end')
          if [ "$RELEASE" = published ]; then
            echo "release already published; preserving its assets"
            exit 0
          elif [ "$RELEASE" = draft ]; then
            echo "::error::An incomplete draft exists for ${TAG}; inspect it before retrying."
            exit 1
          elif [ "$RELEASE" != absent ]; then
            echo "::error::Unexpected release lookup result: ${RELEASE}"
            exit 1
          fi

          # One line per pull request merged since the previous dev build,
          # then the other ways to install this build.
          python3 scripts/build_mirror_release_notes.py \
            --dev-pin "$VERSION" --dist ha-mcp-dev \
            --source "$GITHUB_SHA" --source-label "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${SHORT_SHA}" \
            --out release_notes.md
          cat >> release_notes.md << EOF

          ### Other installs

          **Docker (dev channel):** \`docker pull ghcr.io/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}:dev\`

          **PyPI (dev channel):** \`pip install ha-mcp-dev\`
          EOF

          # Retry an unpublished tag left by a failed create. Public releases
          # exit above so their assets and download history are preserved.
          git tag -f "$TAG" HEAD
          git push --quiet --force "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" "refs/tags/$TAG"
          gh release create "$TAG" dist/integration/ha_mcp_tools.zip \
            --verify-tag \
            --title "Dev Build $VERSION" \
            --notes-file release_notes.md \
            --prerelease

          echo "✓ Created pre-release $TAG"

  cleanup-old-prereleases:
    name: Cleanup old pre-releases
    needs: create-prerelease
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Delete old dev releases (keep last 5)
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          # Get all pre-releases with .dev in the tag, sorted by date
          # gh release list output is tab-separated: TITLE<tab>TYPE<tab>TAG<tab>DATE
          gh release list --repo ${{ github.repository }} --limit 100 \
            | grep -E "\.dev[0-9]+" \
            | tail -n +6 \
            | awk -F'\t' '{print $3}' \
            | while read tag; do
                if [ -n "$tag" ]; then
                  echo "Deleting old dev release: $tag"
                  gh release delete "$tag" --yes --repo ${{ github.repository }} || true
                  gh api -X DELETE "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/refs/tags/$tag" 2>/dev/null || true
                fi
              done

name: Sync Integration Mirror

# Keeps homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp-integration (the HACS distribution mirror)
# in lockstep. The component shares the server's version and pins the server
# build it runs (#2427), so every mirror release is a component + server pair:
#
# - stable: after "Release Publish", the public release's component (stamped by
#   semantic-release with the release version and its ha-mcp== pin) is tagged
#   vX.Y.Z once PyPI serves that ha-mcp build.
# - dev: after "Publish Dev Channel", the snapshot of the commit it built is
#   stamped with the next release number and pinned to the exact build it
#   uploaded (ha-mcp-dev==<next>.devN), and tagged vX.Y.Z-dev.N. Server-only
#   changes therefore reach pre-release users too, not just component changes.
#   main takes the commit's component unstamped, matching master; the stamped
#   snapshot is a commit only the dev tag references.
#
# HACS keys on the GitHub prerelease flag, so stable users never see dev
# builds; users who enable the repository's HACS "Pre-release" switch entity
# receive them. The mirror's README is composed from a permanent prefix blurb
# plus the main repo README (with relative links/images absolutized) so the
# HACS page mirrors the main docs. The mirror carries no hand-made changes.
#
# Both tagging legs run on `workflow_run`, NOT on `release`/`push`: the
# release is created by the release-bot App and its `release: published`
# event does not reliably fan out to this workflow, and a dev tag must wait
# for the PyPI build its pin names. A docs-only push still refreshes the
# mirror's main branch (README) without tagging.
permissions:
  contents: read

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - "hacs.json"
      - "LICENSE"
      - "README.md"
      - ".github/integration-mirror-readme-prefix.md"
      - "scripts/build_mirror_readme.py"
      - ".github/integration-mirror-workflows/**"
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Release Publish", "Publish Dev Channel"]
    types: [completed]
    # Publish Dev Channel also runs on dispatch from any branch; only master
    # builds may reach the mirror.
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      channel:
        description: >-
          stable re-tags the latest stable release (recovery path when a
          release run flaked); dev cuts a v<next>-dev.N pre-release from the
          current master snapshot, pinned to its already-published dev build.
          Dispatch from master only.
        type: choice
        options: [stable, dev]
        default: stable

# Serialize mirror syncs: a release and the dev build after it can both clone
# the mirror and push to main at nearly the same time; without serialization
# the second push is a non-fast-forward rejection. queue: max keeps a queued
# release-tag run from being evicted by a later run (requires
# cancel-in-progress: false).
concurrency:
  group: mirror-sync
  cancel-in-progress: false
  queue: max

jobs:
  # Decide from the TRIGGERING RUN'S JOBS which leg runs. Gating on the run's
  # overall conclusion skipped the mirror tag whenever any UNRELATED leg
  # failed (v7.12.2: an app image cache flake failed the release run and HACS
  # never got the component tag), so each leg keys on the one job it needs:
  # The PyPI job publishes the stable GitHub release before finishing; dev
  # creation requires PyPI and attaches its ZIP. Unreadable jobs prove nothing.
  gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
    outputs:
      channel: ${{ steps.decide.outputs.channel }}
      dev_run: ${{ steps.decide.outputs.dev_run }}
    steps:
      - name: Pick the leg from the trigger
        id: decide
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          DISPATCH_CHANNEL: ${{ inputs.channel }}
          TRIGGER_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.name }}
          TRIGGER_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
          TRIGGER_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          TRIGGER_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          if [ "$TRIGGER_BRANCH" != master ]; then
            echo "::warning::Ignoring a run from ${TRIGGER_BRANCH}; the mirror follows master only."
            echo "channel=skip" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          case "$EVENT" in
            push) echo "channel=none" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0 ;;
            workflow_dispatch)
              if [ "$DISPATCH_CHANNEL" = stable ]; then
                echo "channel=stable" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
                exit 0
              fi
              # A dev dispatch pins the build Publish Dev Channel made of this
              # very commit; there is none for a docs-only commit it skipped.
              TRIGGER_RUN_ID=$(gh api \
                "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/publish-dev.yml/runs?head_sha=${GITHUB_SHA}&per_page=1" \
                --jq '.workflow_runs[0].id // empty')
              if [ -z "$TRIGGER_RUN_ID" ]; then
                echo "::error::Publish Dev Channel never built ${GITHUB_SHA}; nothing to pin."
                exit 1
              fi
              TRIGGER_WORKFLOW="Publish Dev Channel"
              ;;
          esac
          if [ "$TRIGGER_CONCLUSION" = "skipped" ]; then
            echo "Triggering run was skipped in its entirety - nothing to sync."
            echo "channel=skip" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$TRIGGER_WORKFLOW" = "Release Publish" ]; then
            job="Publish PyPI package"; leg=stable
          else
            job="Create GitHub pre-release"; leg=dev
          fi
          if ! conclusion=$(gh api \
            "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${TRIGGER_RUN_ID}/jobs?per_page=100" \
            --jq "[.jobs[] | select(.name == \"$job\") | .conclusion] | first // empty"); then
            if [ "$EVENT" = workflow_dispatch ]; then
              # A maintainer asked for this pre-release: fail and say why.
              echo "::error::Could not query Publish Dev Channel run ${TRIGGER_RUN_ID}'s jobs."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "::warning::Could not query the triggering run's jobs; skipping this build."
              echo "channel=skip" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            fi
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "'$job' conclusion: ${conclusion:-<job absent>}"
          if [ "$conclusion" = success ]; then
            echo "channel=$leg" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "dev_run=$TRIGGER_RUN_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [ "$EVENT" = workflow_dispatch ]; then
            echo "::error::'$job' in Publish Dev Channel run ${TRIGGER_RUN_ID} is ${conclusion:-absent}, not success; no dev build to pin."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "channel=skip" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  sync:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.channel != 'skip'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read  # the dev build's version artifact
    env:
      CHANNEL: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.channel }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # Both legs add a worktree of the commit they snapshot and the
          # notes script compares stable tags; both need full history + tags.
          # This checkout stays on the default branch: the scripts below run
          # from it, never from the snapshotted commit.
          fetch-depth: 0
          fetch-tags: true

      - name: Fetch the dev build's version
        if: env.CHANNEL == 'dev'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8
        with:
          name: dev-version
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dev-version
          run-id: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.dev_run }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Resolve the release this run publishes
        id: release
        env:
          TRIGGER_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          case "$CHANNEL" in
            stable)
              # Follow the current public stable release, never an unpublished
              # tag or master's unstamped tip. Queued/recovery runs converge.
              VER=$(gh release view --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json tagName --jq .tagName)
              VER="${VER#v}"
              SRC="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-src"
              git worktree add --quiet --detach "$SRC" "v${VER}"
              PIN="$VER"
              TAG="v${VER}"
              DIST=ha-mcp
              ;;
            dev)
              # Publish Dev Channel uploaded this commit as ha-mcp-dev; pin the
              # version it uploaded, not a recomputed one.
              PIN=$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-version/dev-version.txt")
              if ! [[ "$PIN" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.dev[0-9]+$ ]]; then
                echo "::error::The dev build reported '${PIN}', not a dev version."
                exit 1
              fi
              VER="${PIN%.dev*}"
              TAG="v${VER}-dev.${PIN##*.dev}"
              DIST=ha-mcp-dev
              # Snapshot the commit Publish Dev Channel built, not whatever
              # master has moved on to since; a dispatch builds this commit.
              if [ -n "$TRIGGER_SHA" ]; then
                SRC="$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-src"
                git worktree add --quiet --detach "$SRC" "$TRIGGER_SHA"
              else
                SRC=.
              fi
              ;;
            *)
              exit 0
              ;;
          esac
          echo "Component ${VER}, ${DIST}==${PIN}, tag ${TAG}"
          {
            echo "version=$VER"
            echo "pin=$PIN"
            echo "dist=$DIST"
            echo "src=$SRC"
            echo "tag=$TAG"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up mirror push key
        env:
          DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.INTEGRATION_MIRROR_DEPLOY_KEY }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          printf -- "%s\n" "$DEPLOY_KEY" > ~/.ssh/mirror_key
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/mirror_key
          ssh-keyscan github.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null

      - name: Clone mirror
        env:
          GIT_SSH_COMMAND: ssh -i ~/.ssh/mirror_key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes
        run: |
          git clone --depth 1 git@github.com:homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp-integration.git /tmp/mirror

      - name: Stage snapshot
        env:
          VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          PIN: ${{ steps.release.outputs.pin }}
          DIST: ${{ steps.release.outputs.dist }}
          SRC: ${{ steps.release.outputs.src }}
        run: |
          if [ "$CHANNEL" = none ]; then
            # A docs-only push refreshes the README and repo files; the
            # component stays exactly as the last tagged sync left it.
            cp hacs.json LICENSE /tmp/mirror/
          else
            # From the snapshot, so hacs.json's Home Assistant minimum always
            # matches the component it ships with.
            cp "$SRC/hacs.json" "$SRC/LICENSE" /tmp/mirror/
            rm -rf /tmp/mirror/custom_components
            mkdir -p /tmp/mirror/custom_components
            cp -r "$SRC/custom_components/ha_mcp_tools" /tmp/mirror/custom_components/
            rm -rf /tmp/mirror/custom_components/ha_mcp_tools/__pycache__
            # main takes master's component as is, like this repository's
            # master; a dev build's stamp goes on a commit only its tag names.
            if [ "$CHANNEL" = stable ]; then
              python3 scripts/stamp_component_version.py \
                --component-dir /tmp/mirror/custom_components/ha_mcp_tools \
                --version "$VER" --pin "$PIN" --dist "$DIST"
            fi
          fi
          python3 scripts/build_mirror_readme.py \
            --prefix .github/integration-mirror-readme-prefix.md \
            --readme README.md \
            --out /tmp/mirror/README.md
          # Deploy keys can push workflow files (unlike a PAT, they aren't
          # subject to the `workflow` scope restriction), and the mirror
          # carries no hand-made changes, so its release-on-tag.yml is
          # synced from here too rather than hand-edited in the mirror.
          mkdir -p /tmp/mirror/.github/workflows
          cp .github/integration-mirror-workflows/release-on-tag.yml \
            /tmp/mirror/.github/workflows/release-on-tag.yml

      - name: Commit and push
        env:
          GIT_SSH_COMMAND: ssh -i ~/.ssh/mirror_key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          cd /tmp/mirror
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "mirror already current"
          else
            git commit -m "Component snapshot from ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${SOURCE_SHA} (${CHANNEL})"
            git push origin main
          fi

      - name: Stamp the dev snapshot
        # Committed on top of main without pushing it; the tag push below
        # publishes this commit, as publish-dev.yml does for master.
        if: env.CHANNEL == 'dev'
        env:
          VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          PIN: ${{ steps.release.outputs.pin }}
          DIST: ${{ steps.release.outputs.dist }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          python3 scripts/stamp_component_version.py \
            --component-dir /tmp/mirror/custom_components/ha_mcp_tools \
            --version "$VER" --pin "$PIN" --dist "$DIST"
          cd /tmp/mirror
          git commit -qam "Component snapshot from ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${SOURCE_SHA} (dev ${PIN})"

      - name: Wait for the pinned server build on PyPI
        # The tag is what HACS installs, and Home Assistant installs the pin
        # from PyPI on the next restart: a tag ahead of its PyPI build would
        # fail every install that picks it up in between.
        if: env.CHANNEL == 'stable' || env.CHANNEL == 'dev'
        env:
          PIN: ${{ steps.release.outputs.pin }}
          DIST: ${{ steps.release.outputs.dist }}
        run: |
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            if curl -fsS -o /dev/null "https://pypi.org/pypi/${DIST}/${PIN}/json"; then
              echo "PyPI serves ${DIST} ${PIN}"
              exit 0
            fi
            sleep 30
          done
          echo "::error::PyPI never served ${DIST} ${PIN}; not tagging a component that pins it."
          exit 1

      - name: Tag the mirror
        if: env.CHANNEL == 'stable' || env.CHANNEL == 'dev'
        env:
          GIT_SSH_COMMAND: ssh -i ~/.ssh/mirror_key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes
          VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          # Captures instead of `| grep -q .`: without pipefail a FAILED
          # ls-remote looks identical to "tag absent"; a bare assignment under
          # set -e aborts loud instead. Every release is a new shared version,
          # so an existing tag only means this run already happened.
          existing=$(git -C /tmp/mirror ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${TAG}")
          if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
            echo "mirror tag ${TAG} exists - nothing to do"
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$CHANNEL" = stable ]; then
            # The tag message is the release body (the deploy key cannot call
            # the API; the mirror's release-on-tag.yml reads the message).
            # --cleanup=verbatim keeps the markdown headings `git tag -F`
            # would otherwise strip as comments.
            python3 scripts/build_mirror_release_notes.py \
              --tag "$TAG" --out /tmp/mirror_notes.md
          else
            stable_exists=$(git -C /tmp/mirror ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/v${VER}")
            if [ -n "$stable_exists" ]; then
              echo "v${VER} is already released as stable - skipping dev tag"
              exit 0
            fi
            # One line per pull request merged since the previous dev build.
            python3 scripts/build_mirror_release_notes.py \
              --dev-pin "${{ steps.release.outputs.pin }}" \
              --dist "${{ steps.release.outputs.dist }}" \
              --source "$SOURCE_SHA" \
              --source-label "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${SOURCE_SHA}" \
              --out /tmp/mirror_notes.md
          fi
          echo "--- release notes for ${TAG} ---"
          cat /tmp/mirror_notes.md
          cd /tmp/mirror
          git tag -a "${TAG}" -F /tmp/mirror_notes.md --cleanup=verbatim
          git push origin "${TAG}"

      id: release
      env:
        TRIGGER_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      run: "case \"$CHANNEL\" in\n  stable)\n    # Follow the current public stable release, never an unpublished\n    # tag\
        \ or master's unstamped tip. Queued/recovery runs converge.\n    VER=$(gh release view --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\
        \ --json tagName --jq .tagName)\n    VER=\"${VER#v}\"\n    SRC=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/release-src\"\n    git worktree add\
        \ --quiet --detach \"$SRC\" \"v${VER}\"\n    PIN=\"$VER\"\n    TAG=\"v${VER}\"\n    DIST=ha-mcp\n    ;;\n  dev)\n\
        \    # Publish Dev Channel uploaded this commit as ha-mcp-dev; pin the\n    # version it uploaded, not a recomputed\
        \ one.\n    PIN=$(cat \"$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-version/dev-version.txt\")\n    if ! [[ \"$PIN\" =~ ^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\\
        .dev[0-9]+$ ]]; then\n      echo \"::error::The dev build reported '${PIN}', not a dev version.\"\n      exit 1\n\
        \    fi\n    VER=\"${PIN%.dev*}\"\n    TAG=\"v${VER}-dev.${PIN##*.dev}\"\n    DIST=ha-mcp-dev\n    # Snapshot the\
        \ commit Publish Dev Channel built, not whatever\n    # master has moved on to since; a dispatch builds this commit.\n\
        \    if [ -n \"$TRIGGER_SHA\" ]; then\n      SRC=\"$RUNNER_TEMP/dev-src\"\n      git worktree add --quiet --detach\
        \ \"$SRC\" \"$TRIGGER_SHA\"\n    else\n      SRC=.\n    fi\n    ;;\n  *)\n    exit 0\n    ;;\nesac\necho \"Component\
        \ ${VER}, ${DIST}==${PIN}, tag ${TAG}\"\n{\n  echo \"version=$VER\"\n  echo \"pin=$PIN\"\n  echo \"dist=$DIST\"\n\
        \  echo \"src=$SRC\"\n  echo \"tag=$TAG\"\n} >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n"
    - name: Set up mirror push key
      env:
        DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.INTEGRATION_MIRROR_DEPLOY_KEY }}
      run: 'mkdir -p ~/.ssh

        printf -- "%s\n" "$DEPLOY_KEY" > ~/.ssh/mirror_key

        chmod 600 ~/.ssh/mirror_key

        ssh-keyscan github.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null

        '
    - name: Clone mirror
      env:
        GIT_SSH_COMMAND: ssh -i ~/.ssh/mirror_key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes
      run: 'git clone --depth 1 git@github.com:julienld/ha-mcp-simple-mirror-qa-20261108.git /tmp/mirror

        '
    - name: Stage snapshot
      env:
        VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
        PIN: ${{ steps.release.outputs.pin }}
        DIST: ${{ steps.release.outputs.dist }}
        SRC: ${{ steps.release.outputs.src }}
      run: "if [ \"$CHANNEL\" = none ]; then\n  # A docs-only push refreshes the README and repo files; the\n  # component\
        \ stays exactly as the last tagged sync left it.\n  cp hacs.json LICENSE /tmp/mirror/\nelse\n  # From the snapshot,\
        \ so hacs.json's Home Assistant minimum always\n  # matches the component it ships with.\n  cp \"$SRC/hacs.json\"\
        \ \"$SRC/LICENSE\" /tmp/mirror/\n  rm -rf /tmp/mirror/custom_components\n  mkdir -p /tmp/mirror/custom_components\n\
        \  cp -r \"$SRC/custom_components/ha_mcp_tools\" /tmp/mirror/custom_components/\n  rm -rf /tmp/mirror/custom_components/ha_mcp_tools/__pycache__\n\
        \  # main takes master's component as is, like this repository's\n  # master; a dev build's stamp goes on a commit\
        \ only its tag names.\n  if [ \"$CHANNEL\" = stable ]; then\n    python3 scripts/stamp_component_version.py \\\n \
        \     --component-dir /tmp/mirror/custom_components/ha_mcp_tools \\\n      --version \"$VER\" --pin \"$PIN\" --dist\
        \ \"$DIST\"\n  fi\nfi\npython3 scripts/build_mirror_readme.py \\\n  --prefix .github/integration-mirror-readme-prefix.md\
        \ \\\n  --readme README.md \\\n  --out /tmp/mirror/README.md\n# Deploy keys can push workflow files (unlike a PAT,\
        \ they aren't\n# subject to the `workflow` scope restriction), and the mirror\n# carries no hand-made changes, so\
        \ its release-on-tag.yml is\n# synced from here too rather than hand-edited in the mirror.\nmkdir -p /tmp/mirror/.github/workflows\n\
        cp .github/integration-mirror-workflows/release-on-tag.yml \\\n  /tmp/mirror/.github/workflows/release-on-tag.yml\n"
    - name: Commit and push
      env:
        GIT_SSH_COMMAND: ssh -i ~/.ssh/mirror_key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes
        SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}
      run: "cd /tmp/mirror\ngit config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\ngit config user.email \"github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\
        \ngit add -A\nif git diff --cached --quiet; then\n  echo \"mirror already current\"\nelse\n  git commit -m \"Component\
        \ snapshot from ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${SOURCE_SHA} (${CHANNEL})\"\n  git push origin main\nfi\n"
    - name: Stamp the dev snapshot
      if: env.CHANNEL == 'dev'
      env:
        VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
        PIN: ${{ steps.release.outputs.pin }}
        DIST: ${{ steps.release.outputs.dist }}
        SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}
      run: "python3 scripts/stamp_component_version.py \\\n  --component-dir /tmp/mirror/custom_components/ha_mcp_tools \\\
        \n  --version \"$VER\" --pin \"$PIN\" --dist \"$DIST\"\ncd /tmp/mirror\ngit commit -qam \"Component snapshot from\
        \ ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${SOURCE_SHA} (dev ${PIN})\"\n"
    - name: Wait for the pinned server build on PyPI
      if: env.CHANNEL == 'stable' || env.CHANNEL == 'dev'
      env:
        PIN: ${{ steps.release.outputs.pin }}
        DIST: ${{ steps.release.outputs.dist }}
      run: "for _ in $(seq 1 60); do\n  if curl -fsS -o /dev/null \"https://julienld.github.io/ha-mcp-simple-mirror-qa-20261108/pypi/${DIST}/${PIN}/json\"\
        ; then\n    echo \"PyPI serves ${DIST} ${PIN}\"\n    exit 0\n  fi\n  sleep 30\ndone\necho \"::error::PyPI never served\
        \ ${DIST} ${PIN}; not tagging a component that pins it.\"\nexit 1\n"
    - name: Tag the mirror
      if: env.CHANNEL == 'stable' || env.CHANNEL == 'dev'
      env:
        GIT_SSH_COMMAND: ssh -i ~/.ssh/mirror_key -o IdentitiesOnly=yes
        VER: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
        TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
        SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha || github.sha }}
      run: "# Captures instead of `| grep -q .`: without pipefail a FAILED\n# ls-remote looks identical to \"tag absent\"\
        ; a bare assignment under\n# set -e aborts loud instead. Every release is a new shared version,\n# so an existing\
        \ tag only means this run already happened.\nexisting=$(git -C /tmp/mirror ls-remote --tags origin \"refs/tags/${TAG}\"\
        )\nif [ -n \"$existing\" ]; then\n  echo \"mirror tag ${TAG} exists - nothing to do\"\n  exit 0\nfi\nif [ \"$CHANNEL\"\
        \ = stable ]; then\n  # The tag message is the release body (the deploy key cannot call\n  # the API; the mirror's\
        \ release-on-tag.yml reads the message).\n  # --cleanup=verbatim keeps the markdown headings `git tag -F`\n  # would\
        \ otherwise strip as comments.\n  python3 scripts/build_mirror_release_notes.py \\\n    --tag \"$TAG\" --out /tmp/mirror_notes.md\n\
        else\n  stable_exists=$(git -C /tmp/mirror ls-remote --tags origin \"refs/tags/v${VER}\")\n  if [ -n \"$stable_exists\"\
        \ ]; then\n    echo \"v${VER} is already released as stable - skipping dev tag\"\n    exit 0\n  fi\n  # One line per\
        \ pull request merged since the previous dev build.\n  python3 scripts/build_mirror_release_notes.py \\\n    --dev-pin\
        \ \"${{ steps.release.outputs.pin }}\" \\\n    --dist \"${{ steps.release.outputs.dist }}\" \\\n    --source \"$SOURCE_SHA\"\
        \ \\\n    --source-label \"${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${SOURCE_SHA}\" \\\n    --out /tmp/mirror_notes.md\nfi\necho \"---\
        \ release notes for ${TAG} ---\"\ncat /tmp/mirror_notes.md\ncd /tmp/mirror\ngit tag -a \"${TAG}\" -F /tmp/mirror_notes.md\
        \ --cleanup=verbatim\ngit push origin \"${TAG}\"\n"
    outputs:
      qa_tag: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
      qa_pin: ${{ steps.release.outputs.pin }}
      qa_dist: ${{ steps.release.outputs.dist }}
      qa_channel: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.channel }}
  qa_receipt:
    name: QA workflow receipt
    needs:
    - gate
    - sync
    if: ${{ always() && vars.QA_ARMED == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
        ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
    - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e
      with:
        version: 0.13.4
    - run: uv run -s .qa/record.py
      env:
        QA_NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        QA_STAGE: ${{ vars.QA_STAGE }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        QA_REPORT_FAILURES: 'false'
        QA_OBSERVER_PR: ${{ vars.QA_OBSERVER_PR }}
        QA_OBSERVER_SHA: ${{ vars.QA_OBSERVER_SHA }}
        QA_FAIL_DOCKER: ${{ vars.QA_FAIL_DOCKER }}
    - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
      with:
        name: qa-workflow-receipt
        path: qa-workflow-receipt.json
        retention-days: 30

name: Deploy to GitHub Pages

# The site is built from the `stable` tag, not master, so the published setup
# instructions always match the current stable release. A site change merged
# to master goes live at the next stable release, or sooner by dispatching
# this workflow with another `ref`. That override lasts only until the next
# scheduled or release-driven rebuild.
#
# Stable releases arrive through workflow_run rather than a release or tag
# trigger: the github-pages environment only lets runs on `master` deploy,
# and workflow_run runs on the default branch, while release and tag-push
# runs carry the tag as their ref. Dev pre-releases come from a different
# workflow and never trigger a deploy.
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Release Publish"]
    types: [completed]
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/deploy.yml'
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 3 * * 0'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: "Tag or commit to build the site from (default: the stable tag)"
        required: false
        default: stable
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    # Rebuild after the stable publisher completes; a failed publisher leaves
    # the existing site usable until its retry succeeds.
    if: ${{ github.event_name != 'workflow_run' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./site
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          # Every non-dispatch trigger builds `stable`; on a gated-out release
          # week the tag has not moved, so the rebuild is a no-op.
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || 'stable' }}

      - name: Generate star history charts
        # The built-in token cannot access GitHub's restricted stargazer history.
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.STAR_HISTORY_TOKEN }}
        run: >-
          python3 ../scripts/generate_star_history.py
          --repository "${{ github.repository }}"
          --output-dir public/star-history

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7
        with:
          # Corepack is bundled only through Node 24; `corepack npm ci` enforces packageManager.
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: site/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: corepack npm ci

      - name: Build with Astro
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@fc324d3547104276b827a68afc52ff2a11cc49c9 # v5
        with:
          path: ./site/dist

  deploy:
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@368f82528645a54fb793d4d04e342629a3f51346 # v5

name: Home Assistant Add-on Publish

on:
  # Called from semver-release.yml after version bump
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Add-on version to publish'
        required: true
        type: string
  # Also support manual dispatch
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version override (leave empty to use config.yaml)'
        required: false
        type: string

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_PREFIX: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}-addon

jobs:
  build-addon:
    name: Build Add-on Image (${{ matrix.arch }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    strategy:
      matrix:
        arch:
          - amd64
          - aarch64
        include:
          - arch: amd64
            platform: linux/amd64
          - arch: aarch64
            platform: linux/arm64

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
        submodules: true
        # Check out the release tag so uv sync installs the bumped pyproject.toml.
        # Without this, GITHUB_SHA points to the pre-semantic-release merge commit
        # and the installed package metadata would reflect the previous version.
        # Falls back to GITHUB_SHA for manual dispatch without a version input.
        ref: ${{ inputs.version && format('v{0}', inputs.version) || github.sha }}

    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4

    - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
      uses: docker/login-action@81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6 # v4
      with:
        registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
        username: ${{ github.actor }}
        password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Resolve version
      id: version
      run: |
        if [ -n "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
          VERSION="${{ inputs.version }}"
        else
          VERSION=$(grep '^version:' homeassistant-addon/config.yaml | sed 's/version: "\(.*\)"/\1/')
        fi
        echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        echo "Add-on version: $VERSION"

    - name: Build and push Docker image
      uses: ./.github/actions/docker-build-python-base-fallback
      with:
        context: .
        file: ./homeassistant-addon/Dockerfile
        push: true
        platforms: ${{ matrix.platform }}
        tags: |
          ${{ env.IMAGE_PREFIX }}-${{ matrix.arch }}:latest
          ${{ env.IMAGE_PREFIX }}-${{ matrix.arch }}:${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
        labels: |
          io.hass.name=Home Assistant MCP Server
          io.hass.description=AI assistant integration via Model Context Protocol
          io.hass.version=${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          io.hass.type=addon
          io.hass.arch=${{ matrix.arch }}
        cache-from: type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.arch }}
        # ignore-error: cache export is best-effort. Without it, an Actions
        # cache-service failure fails the whole image publish — observed live
        # on v7.12.2: five attempts all died on "error writing layer blob:
        # failed to reserve cache" (the repeats appear to be abandoned upload
        # reservations from the failed attempts blocking re-reservation of the
        # same blob keys; the cache-service internals are not documented).
        # Whatever the mechanism, a cache write must never fail the publish —
        # a lost export only costs the next build a warm start.
        cache-to: type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ matrix.arch }},ignore-error=true
        build-args: |
          BUILD_VERSION=${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          BUILD_ARCH=${{ matrix.arch }}

name: Update Add-on Config Version

# Reusable workflow to update addon config.yaml after Docker images are published.
# Called from semver-release.yml and addon-publish-dev.yml.

# images were published out-of-band (addon-publish.yml's own dispatch), this is
# the recovery path for the config.yaml version bump — the calling release run
# cannot be re-run with fixed workflow code (reruns pin the original commit's
# workflows). ONLY dispatch with a version whose ghcr images actually exist:
# config.yaml's version selects the image tag HAOS installs.
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Version to set in config.yaml (without v prefix)'
        required: true
        type: string
      config_path:
        description: 'Path to config.yaml to update'
        required: false
        type: string
